# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_reservation (Resource)

Manages a Kea DHCPv4 host reservation on OPNsense, pinning an IPv4 address to a client MAC address within a subnet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hw_address` (String) Client MAC address the reservation matches (e.g. `00:11:22:33:44:55`).
- `ip_address` (String) Reserved IPv4 address (must fall within the subnet).
- `subnet_id` (String) UUID of the Kea DHCPv4 subnet this reservation belongs to.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) Client-id the reservation matches (colon-separated hex, alternative to `hw_address`).
- `description` (String) Description of the reservation.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname assigned to the client.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the reservation.
